verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents exporting financial statements on cash or accrual basis in Excel, CSV and PDF, and advertises one-click real-time financial reports. Its MCP lets users ask for an income statement for a period such as "this quarter," and bank reconciliation supports report accuracy. However, the evidence never names a balance sheet or cash-flow statement, and never shows arbitrary period selection; the cash flow forecast is a different capability. Missing for 10: explicit balance sheet and statement-of-cash-flows documentation, documented any-period/custom date-range selection, independent or hands-on corroboration of statement accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand

citations.quote: you can export a full general ledger and financial statements on either cash or accrual basis in excel, csv, and pdf formats.
